title: Organization member DTO (B.6, GET /members)
description: One organization_members roster row joined with its user. A roster row has no version of its own (it is a child of the organization aggregate); lists use updatedSince on the roster row's updatedAt. Also the `data` of organization.member.* events (removed: last snapshot + deleted:true).

displayName.description: The optional `users.displayName` (EW-P2-6); null when the person set none. Consumers fall back to username.

role.description: `owner` (the Tenant owner), `admin` (may create integration keys pinned to this organization, EW-P2-6) or `member`. Consumers must accept unknown values.

everIdSubjects.description: external_identities rows (Ever ID): the automatic people-matching key (01 §3). Never matched by email.
